title: SEO Site Profile
description: Personalised SEO/GEO criteria for one site. Data only — selects and prioritises, never invents metrics. Consumed by skills via {{site:<key>}} tokens.

language_paths.description: Language code -> URL path prefix (e.g. {"EN": "/", "RU": "/ru/"}). Default language maps to '/'.

sections.description: Site sections, e.g. Service pages, Blog, Homepage

priority_keywords.description: Keywords that matter most, grouped by language code (keys should be in `languages`). `site_profile.py --get priority_keywords` flattens; `--lang <code>` returns one language.

brand_terms.description: Branded terms for the brand vs non-brand split

markets.description: Target markets (country codes, or the sentinel WORLDWIDE)
